Predict Mean and Variance from Precomputed GP Internals

obtain_mean_var_internal.Rd

Given a pre-fitted GP model from predict_gp_internal, this function predicts the posterior mean and variance at new input locations.

Usage

obtain_mean_var_internal(xnew, intern, covfn, D)

Arguments

xnew

A numeric matrix or vector of new input locations (each row is a point).

intern

The precomputed GP internals as returned by predict_gp_internal, including Cholesky factors, alpha vector, (optionally) regression coefficients, etc.

covfn

A covariance function (e.g., from cov_generator) taking two arguments, returning a covariance matrix between inputs.

D

Integer; the dimension of the input space.

Value

A list with:

mean

Posterior predictive mean at xnew.

var

Posterior predictive covariance matrix at xnew.

Details

It reuses all precomputed Cholesky factors and regression coefficients to avoid redundant matrix decompositions, supporting both zero-mean GP models and those with a quadratic mean function.

Examples

# Example usage (assuming `intern` has been fitted):
# result <- obtain_mean_var_internal(new_points, intern, covfn, D)
